name: BrawlerPad
notes: BrawlerPad owns padmint.json (steps around its existing scripts; ROM chosen in the app).

commands: brew install cmake ninja python@3.11 dylibbundler

steps: Open {file} and move BrawlerPad.app to your Applications folder.
Open BrawlerPad. The first time, it asks for your own Super Smash Bros. (NTSC-U v1.0) ROM: choose Browse… and then Extract.
Updating? Replace the old BrawlerPad.app with the new one. Your saves are kept.
